title: How to Add a Catalog to WhatsApp Business (2026 Steps)
description: How to add a catalog to WhatsApp Business on Android and iPhone: add items, required fields, sharing, hiding and deleting. Checked against WhatsApp help.
h1: How to add a catalog to WhatsApp Business, step by step
answer: To add a catalog to WhatsApp Business, open the Tools tab, tap Catalog, then tap Add new item. Add photos, a product name and the country of origin, then tap Save. WhatsApp reviews each item and shows it to customers once it is approved.
waText: Hi OneCatalog, I want help with a product catalogue.

sections.h2: Before you add a catalog to WhatsApp Business

blocks.p: The catalog is a feature of the WhatsApp Business app, not the normal WhatsApp app. Your catalog shows on your business profile. For each product, have these ready:

ul: A unique product name. WhatsApp requires every item to have a unique title.
At least one clear photo. You can add up to 10 photos or videos per item.
The country of origin. WhatsApp requires this for every item.
Optional: price, sale price, description, website link and product code.

ol: Tap **Gallery** to choose photos or videos, or **Camera** to take new ones.
Enter the product or service name.
Tap **Country of origin**, choose the country and tap **Save**.
Add any optional details, such as price or description.

blocks.p: The steps are the same as Android, except the photo step. After **Add photos and videos**, tap **Photo & video library**, select your media and tap **Next**, or tap **Camera** to take new ones.

WhatsApp reviews every image, video and item to check it meets its business policy. Items appear to customers only after approval. If an item is rejected, a red exclamation icon shows next to it, and you can tap it and choose **Request another review**. Our [catalog approval time guide](/guides/whatsapp-catalog-approval-time) explains the review in detail.
To share one product on Android, WhatsApp says to go to **Tools**, then **Catalog**, select the item and tap **Share**. You can then:

ul: Send the link in a WhatsApp chat.
Share it over email or another messaging app.

blocks.p: WhatsApp notes that the auto-generated catalog link cannot be customised, and may break if you try to change it.

To hide an item on Android, open it from **Tools**, then **Catalog**, tap the menu and choose **Hide**. On iPhone, open the item, tap **Edit**, turn on **Hide this item** and tap **Save**. WhatsApp says hiding might not be available to everyone yet.
To delete on Android, long press the product image, tap the delete icon, then **Delete**. On iPhone, swipe left on the product and tap **Delete**.
To group items, create collections. See our guide to [WhatsApp catalogue categories](/guides/whatsapp-catalog-categories).

Adding 50 products one by one takes time. If you would rather send your photos and price list and get a finished catalogue back, OneCatalog builds it for you as one web link that works alongside your WhatsApp catalog. See our [WhatsApp catalogue page](/whatsapp-catalogue).

items.q: Can I add a catalog in the normal WhatsApp app?
items.a: No. The catalog is a feature of the WhatsApp Business app. It shows on your business profile.

items.q: What details are required for each item?
items.a: WhatsApp requires a unique title, at least one image and the country of origin. Price and description are optional.

items.q: How many photos can one item have?
items.a: Up to 10 images or videos. WhatsApp says a video can be up to 50 MB.

items.q: Can I add many products at once?
items.a: Not in the app. For bulk uploads, see our [bulk upload guide](/guides/whatsapp-catalog-bulk-upload).
